subject: s-proj
title: S.PROJ.------MTH.
description: Chart on book p. 165 (UPB(II)-27). S-PROJ (source projection) is the subject; MTH (methodology) is the partner. From the subject: ALT-F (alternative functionalism), AFL (affinity alignment) and IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From ALT-F: TR-INFO (trans-information). From TR-INFO: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From AFL: FUND-DYM (fundamental dynamics). From IST-S-ALGN: CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism) and SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics). From CRTF-PROG: MTH-2 (methodology, a second MTH label). From SCI-DYM: AF-NT (affinity nature). The page text speaks of "the dynamic implication of composite methodology".
